body.matters: where authority over meaning and action sits
body.prose: The paper keeps circling one problem: how a whole can act together when its parts keep their own insides, their own vocabularies and their own judgement. Every move it makes, from virtues given bodies to meanings agreed at runtime to a rehearsal in simulation, is a way of binding without absorbing.

name: Coordinating parts one does not own

body.matters: how much a part keeps for itself
body.prose: A holon is set apart from an agent by being nested: it answers upward while keeping a bounded freedom. The lineage runs from a philosopher's idea through factory floors into grids and buildings.

body.matters: rank in the nest
body.prose: Position in the holarchy decides how far a holon may decide; authority is spread across levels yet still thickens toward the top.

name: Nesting sets the reach of freedom

body.matters: the line that separates the two kinds
body.prose: Agents act flat and free; holons add organisational awareness across levels, and a holonic agent is the hybrid. Humans in the loop and agentic AI blur the line further.

body.matters: which domain the idea migrates into next
body.prose: From Koestler to holonic manufacturing to smart grids, construction and data pipelines, the idea spreads wherever control must be decentralised.

body.matters: which concern earns its own holon
body.prose: Concerns that autonomous systems handle badly are each handed to a specialised kind of holon, so that ethics, horizon, meaning, fairness and watchfulness become roles rather than properties of one mind.

body.matters: the shortfall being answered
body.prose: Brittle adaptation, embedded bias, missing accountability and thin awareness are named first; the roles are cut to fit them.

body.matters: what a decision is tested against
body.prose: Two roles stand beside a decision rather than making it: one tests it against norms, the other against known distortions.

body.matters: the encoded norm
body.prose: Ethics is written into ontologies and rule systems and weighed alongside operational goals, with the hard part being which norms and at what cost to speed.

body.matters: detectability of a bias
body.prose: Bias is treated as patterns that can be catalogued and audited in a loop, borrowing from fault detection.

body.matters: time horizon of the objective
body.prose: Effective holons weigh consequences beyond the goal at hand, which forces a question of how effect is ever measured.

name: The long horizon against the quick win

body.matters: the structure that makes data interpretable
body.prose: Understanding holons turn mixed data into situational knowledge through ontologies and inference, at the cost of building and keeping those ontologies.

body.matters: alignment between local and global
body.prose: Vigilant holons share awareness so that locally sound choices do not drift out of line with the whole; they become the orchestrators.

body.matters: the direction of flow among roles
body.prose: Checks flow into the effective holon, understanding feeds both, and vigilance spans all layers; the roles form a small holarchy of their own.

name: How the roles feed one another

body.matters: the recurring scene
body.prose: Hospitals, disasters, cities and roads recur under nearly every role, so the examples act as shared ground the roles are tried on.

body.matters: when agreement about meaning is struck
body.prose: Rather than forcing one model on all, agreement is negotiated between parties when they meet, and a dedicated holon is built to broker it.

name: Meaning agreed at the meeting point

body.matters: how much each party must give up
body.prose: One can impose a format, share a meta-model, or translate case by case; only the last leaves each party whole.

body.matters: the lifespan of a shared meaning
body.prose: Short-lived ontologies are temporary semantic contracts struck for one exchange and discarded after, so coherence never needs a permanent repository.

name: Ontologies made to be thrown away

body.matters: which organ does the binding
body.prose: The federated interoperability holon is given organs: an orchestrator, a graph of what can connect to what, a translator, a finder, and a workflow maker and runner, with language models proposed for the thinking parts.

body.matters: which role sits inside the mediator
body.prose: Inside the broker the five roles reappear as its subholons: fairness for retrieval, ethics as a validation layer, vigilance as orchestration.

body.matters: whether mediating becomes ruling
body.prose: The broker is said to work without central control yet is also named the highest authority; coordination and command lean against each other.

name: A mediator that sits on top

body.matters: who steers the run
body.prose: Simulation is not only a model of the holons but something they steer; the system builds a mirror of itself in which it can be tried and corrected.

body.matters: what is carried over from agents
body.prose: Holon-directed simulation is derived by analogy from agent-directed simulation and its line of emergent social models.

body.matters: how far a holon may alter the run
body.prose: Holons range from passive sources of data to proactive authors of the simulation's rules.

body.matters: fidelity between the system and its double
body.prose: Each holon gets a federate double under a manager that is itself a subholon of the broker; errors flag upward and invalidate results.

name: A federate twin of the system

body.matters: where nothing arrives
body.prose: The sparse countryside becomes the place to try the whole; its most distinctive aim is finding where no transport reaches at all.

body.matters: the visibility of gaps
body.prose: Beyond routing trips, the system surfaces zones people avoid for lack of options.

name: Deserts as the thing to find

body.matters: which role handles which step
body.prose: Traveller, transport, infrastructure and communication holons each take one of the five roles, and a request is passed through them to a route.

body.matters: the promised gain
body.prose: Scalability, flexibility, fairness and lower emissions are named as outcomes of the arrangement.

body.matters: distance between concept and evidence
body.prose: The authors frame the roles as analytical constructs, not implementations, list open obstacles, and call the case a demonstration rather than a test.

body.matters: fidelity of the text to itself
body.prose: The text as held carries its own fractures: a sentence broken across a heading, examples copied from one role into another, barrier labels crossed, an empty bullet.

body.matters: continuity of a single thought
body.prose: A list item begun at the end of one section finishes inside another, after two other bullets, so a list of requirements is scattered.

body.matters: whether a passage belongs where it stands
body.prose: The effective holon's examples repeat the ethical holon's word for word, and the descriptions of organisational and technological barriers are swapped.

body.matters: how a part stays itself while acting in a whole
body.prose: The held space is about parts that keep their own meaning and their own judgement and must still act as one. It answers twice: meaning is agreed locally and briefly where parts meet, while authority quietly gathers in a single coordinating holon at the top.

body.matters: where meaning is kept and who shares it
body.prose: Under nearly every proposal lies one move: put knowledge into an explicit structure of concepts so a holon can interpret what reaches it. Comprehension is treated as the precondition for every other capability.

body.matters: turning data into situational knowledge
body.prose: A prior dictionary of understanding seeds the whole idea of holons that comprehend, and returns as the understanding holon that fuses scattered data into knowledge of a situation.

body.matters: whether a value can be written down as structure
body.prose: Ethics, fairness and comprehension are all to be realised the same way, as concepts written into an ontology that a decision can be checked against. Different virtues share a single kind of machinery.

body.matters: how long an agreement on meaning must last
body.prose: Instead of one lasting shared vocabulary, parts make small temporary vocabularies for a task or an episode and drop them afterwards. Meaning becomes a contract with a lifetime.

body.matters: what a stranger needs to be understood
body.prose: A newcomer finds, reads and speaks with the others at the moment it joins, with no prior agreement, by building or aligning a vocabulary on the spot.

body.matters: coexistence of several states of meaning
body.prose: Short-lived ontologies act as temporary semantic contracts, versioned and mapped across states, letting different kinds of holons negotiate priorities without a global ontology.

body.matters: the amount of common structure imposed
body.prose: Three ways to make systems interoperate differ in what they force everyone to hold in common: one format, one shared layer, or nothing fixed at all. The federated way is chosen because it asks for the least.

body.matters: whether a quality is a trait or a part
body.prose: Ethical, effective, understanding, unbiased and vigilant are not offered as properties of every holon but as kinds of holon, separate parts that carry one quality each for the rest.

body.matters: which deficit each kind is cast against
body.prose: Every proposed kind of holon is the mirror of one named shortfall of autonomous systems: brittleness, bias, moral blindness, shallow context, poor shared awareness.

body.matters: the direction evaluations flow
body.prose: The kinds pass judgements among themselves: checks of fairness and safety flow to the one that weighs short against long term, comprehension feeds both, and vigilance watches across all levels.

body.matters: the job a quality is assigned when built
body.prose: Once placed inside the coordinating holon and the mobility system, each quality takes on an operational job: the unbiased one becomes storage and translation of messages, the vigilant one becomes the orchestrator, the understanding one faces the traveller.

body.matters: what remains undefined
body.prose: Each quality stops at the same wall: its guidelines, its metric, its ontology or its detector has not been defined, and is deferred to future algorithms.

body.matters: where a decision finally sits
body.prose: Holons are said to keep local autonomy without central control, yet the system repeatedly places one holon above the others with the highest authority. The holarchy leans back toward a pyramid at its apex.

body.matters: scope set by level
body.prose: A holon is whole and part at once, and its reach is set by where it sits in the nesting; this is what separates it from a free agent.

body.matters: who can rearrange the others
body.prose: The coordinating holon is the superholon with highest authority, its orchestrator likely a language model that reasons and picks tools, able to restructure workflows and the holons themselves.

body.matters: the boundary coordination does not cross
body.prose: Against that, the coordination is described as never reaching into a holon's internal logic: each keeps its representations and decisions, and coordination happens only between them.

body.matters: the domains the form has entered
body.prose: The nested form moved from a philosophical idea into manufacturing control and then to grids, construction and cyber-physical systems, each time to escape central control.

body.matters: the relation between a thing and its copy
body.prose: The system is paired with copies of itself, digital twins of the physical and simulation federates of the holons, and the copies are allowed to steer what they copy.

body.matters: degree of direction over the run
body.prose: Simulation with agents is carried over to holons and graded by how much the holons steer the run, from passive sources of data to rewriting the rules and goals of the simulation.

body.matters: keeping the copy synchronised and honest
body.prose: In the case, each holon gets a federate version connected back to it, managed by a reduced copy of the coordinating holon; discrepancies are flagged upward and results invalidated.

body.matters: freshness of data reaching a holon
body.prose: Digital twins and learning at the edge supply the continuous data that lets holons decide locally and reconfigure without a central collector.

body.matters: when a commitment is made
body.prose: Almost every commitment is moved from design time to the moment of use: links, vocabularies, workflows and roles are formed when needed and undone when not.

body.matters: what is discoverable and composable
body.prose: The coordinating holon keeps a graph of every element's capabilities, finds elements in it and composes workflows from them, with generation and execution removable for less autonomy.

name: A graph of what can be done

body.matters: the kinds of mediation needed
body.prose: Its work is translating, aligning goals, gathering data, arbitrating conflicts and reshaping roles, all while running.

body.matters: what is missing in the territory
body.prose: The rural mobility case tests the whole on sparse territory, where the most distinctive output is not a route but a located gap: places where no transport reaches.

body.matters: gaps between demand and service
body.prose: By gathering requests, routes and avoided zones, the system is meant to reveal areas without means of travel and report them to those who could serve them.

body.matters: the order in which roles act
body.prose: A request passes from the traveller-facing holon through transport and infrastructure holons, via a translating communication holon, to optimised routes returned to the user.

body.matters: what is demonstrated and what is hoped
body.prose: Benefits of scale, fairness and lower emissions are claimed, while the closing admits no empirical validation and calls the roles analytical constructs.

body.matters: fidelity of the text to itself
body.prose: The reading carries traces of assembly: application examples copied verbatim between two kinds of holon, two barrier definitions exchanged, stray bullets and broken fragments. The text does not always agree with itself.

body.matters: where coherence is made to live
body.prose: The held space is about parts that refuse to dissolve into the system and yet must act as one. Its weight moves from the parts, to what passes between them, to whoever arranges the passing, and then it is rehearsed and grounded in a place.

name: Wholes that keep themselves and still meet

body.matters: what a part refuses to give up
body.prose: Each part stays whole: it keeps its own model, logic and scope. What it carries is described as kinds of attention it can bring to a shared decision.

body.matters: level of nesting
body.prose: A part is also a whole at another scale; authority runs down the nest while autonomy stays local. The idea travels from philosophy to factories to grids and sites.

body.matters: degree of local freedom
body.prose: Freedom is graded rather than absolute: a part decides locally within bounds set by its position and the objectives above it.

body.matters: what a part is attending to
body.prose: The five new roles read best as five things a part can be looking at: what is right, how far ahead, what things mean, and what the others are doing.

body.matters: which norm is checked
body.prose: Ethical and unbiased roles both encode norms as explicit structure, rules or ontologies of known distortions, and check decisions against them.

body.matters: length of the time horizon
body.prose: The effective role stretches a decision over time and consequence, setting long-term worth against quick economy.

body.matters: depth of interpretation
body.prose: The understanding role turns mixed data into situational meaning through structured vocabularies and inference.

body.matters: breadth of shared awareness
body.prose: The vigilant role watches across levels so that locally informed parts do not drift globally apart; it shades into the orchestrator.

body.matters: direction of flow between roles
body.prose: The roles are wired into a flow: checks feed the balancer, meaning feeds the checks, watching spans all of it.

body.matters: when agreement is formed
body.prose: Because no part gives up its own terms, meaning has to be made where parts touch. The question becomes when agreement forms, and how long it lasts.

body.matters: which layer the mismatch sits in
body.prose: Before meeting can be designed, the kinds of mismatch and the layers they occur in are mapped: meaning, organisation, technology; data, service, process, business.

body.matters: how much is shared in advance
body.prose: Agreement can be one shared format, one shared middle layer, or none at all with translation case by case. The last is the only one that leaves each part untouched.

body.matters: lifespan of a shared meaning
body.prose: Agreement is formed at runtime as a small, disposable vocabulary for one exchange, then thrown away or revised. Coherence becomes something renewed, not stored.

body.matters: what is presupposed rather than built
body.prose: The plumbing under the meeting, protocols, formats, security, is named but set aside as given, while standards and scale remain open burdens.

body.matters: who holds authority over the joins
body.prose: Once meetings must be made on the fly, someone has to make them; coordination gathers into a single role that binds the others, and the nest regains a top.

body.matters: kind of mediation performed
body.prose: The proposed connector translates, aligns goals, merges data and settles conflicts; it carries no task of its own besides holding the rest together.

name: A part whose work is the others

body.matters: which component does the linking
body.prose: Inside, it is a small machine: a deciding core, a registry of what can link to what, a translator, a finder, and a builder and runner of workflows, with language models proposed for the reasoning and translating parts.

body.matters: where final authority rests
body.prose: Decentralisation is the stated aim, yet the arranger ends with the highest authority and may restructure everything below it. Distribution and apex sit side by side.

body.matters: distance between the system and its double
body.prose: The idea is put to work once in a place and once in a rehearsal of that place, where the parts themselves become the actors that run and judge the run.

body.matters: how much the simulated steer the simulation
body.prose: Inherited from agent simulation, a ladder is drawn from parts that only report, to parts that react, learn, and finally rewrite the simulation's own rules.

body.matters: what is inherited from agents
body.prose: Emergent patterns from simple local rules, and agents that model, support or monitor simulations, are the ancestry; nesting adds levels to it.

body.matters: rung of autonomy over the run
body.prose: Four rungs from passive data source to proactive rule-maker, with the practical demands of each.

body.matters: fidelity of the double to its part
body.prose: Each part gets a double in a federation that shares time; the double plays users, flags discrepancies upward, and scores travel time, emissions and access.

body.matters: where absence becomes visible
body.prose: The roles are cast onto travellers, services, infrastructure and a communication part; the place chosen is defined by what is missing in it.

body.matters: which role each actor plays
body.prose: Every abstract role finds a concrete holder, and requests run a numbered path from user to routes and back under the arranger's control.

body.matters: what the absence of travel reveals
body.prose: Beyond routing, the system's second use is to locate places without transport, turning avoidance and silence in the data into a map of need.

body.matters: where the held text fails to join
body.prose: The held text has its own seams: two passages repeated under a different role, two categories whose descriptions trade places, and fragments cut off at page breaks.

body.matters: how much coherence is reached without central control, and whether the proposal stays conceptual or is tested
body.prose: The whole reads as a proposal to extend holonic systems so that they hold ethical, effective, understanding, unbiased and vigilant roles, coordinated by one federating holon, and then to test that arrangement in simulation and in a single transport setting. It stays a conceptual framework that is argued for rather than measured.

name: A holarchy that trades pure efficiency for coordination

body.matters: how nested autonomy is bounded by position in the hierarchy
body.prose: Before any new role is added, the paper rests on what a holon is: a whole that is also a part, nested in levels of autonomy, with a lineage that began in manufacturing and spread outward. The pressures that make autonomous systems fall short are set against that ground as the reason for change.

body.matters: the balance between local freedom and directives from above
body.prose: A holon is autonomous in its own scope yet bound by the level above it, so authority is spread across the tiers instead of concentrated at the top. Local decisions align with system objectives through that bounded autonomy.

body.matters: the domain in which holarchy is applied and the kind of control it replaces
body.prose: The idea starts with a philosophical notion of entities working at several levels at once, is taken up in production systems for flexibility against centralised control, and then spreads into smart grids, construction and cyber-physical work. Each step keeps the holarchy but changes the domain it serves.

body.matters: which failure mode is treated as the most serious gap
body.prose: Autonomous systems are described as brittle under change, prone to bias, short of accountability and thin on shared awareness. These are offered as the gaps the holonic extension is meant to close, and the case rests on them.

name: Limits of autonomous systems as the spur

body.matters: how much live data a holon can draw on while staying locally autonomous
body.prose: Digital twins, federated learning and AI models are presented as a way to give holons live data, fault tolerance and self-optimisation. The remedy is argued as compatible with holonic autonomy rather than as a replacement for it.

name: AI and twins as a remedy

body.matters: which failure of a narrow optimiser each role is meant to answer
body.prose: The paper names five roles a holon can take on, each answering a particular failure of efficiency-first autonomy. Two of them pull against each other, three concern what a holon knows and how it watches, and every one of them carries its own difficulties in definition.

body.matters: how a value is weighed when the short-term and long-term or the fair and the fast disagree
body.prose: Ethical holons and effective holons are set as a balancing pair: one guards fairness and safety, the other looks past short-term efficiency to sustainability and long-run outcomes. The two are expected to meet in negotiation rather than in a single rule.

body.matters: the fidelity of what a holon knows and how far that knowledge is shared
body.prose: Three roles concern what a holon knows and how it watches. Understanding is structured knowledge, unbiased is a check against distortion in that knowledge, and vigilance is shared awareness across holons that keeps local views from drifting away from the whole.

name: Understanding, bias and vigilance as knowing

body.matters: whether the criteria for a role can be written down precisely enough to be checked
body.prose: The paper's own challenge lists show a recurring edge: a role cannot be implemented until its criteria are written down, whether those are ethical guidelines, effectiveness metrics, ontologies or bias patterns. The difficulty is less in the concept than in fixing what counts as success.

name: Where each role gets hard to define

body.matters: the degree of autonomy a holon holds over the run it is part of
body.prose: Simulation is recast so that holons are both the entities being simulated and the agents that steer the run. The section sorts the ways this can happen by how much autonomy the holons hold, and argues that the directing role is a new step beyond agent-based simulation.

name: Holons that direct their own simulation

body.matters: how far a holon may alter the rules or objectives of the simulation it sits in
body.prose: Agent-directed simulation is taken over and sorted into passive, reactive, adaptive and proactive forms of holon-directed simulation, ordered by how much a holon may change the rules or objectives of a run. The sort follows the paper's own categories.

body.matters: what distinguishes a holon acting in a run from an agent acting in one
body.prose: The paper claims holon-directed simulation as a first formal use of the term and as a natural extension of agent-based work, with requirements for real-time adaptation and coordination. The claim is made largely by argument and analogy rather than by a worked method.

name: Holon-directed simulation as a new step

body.matters: how far alignment can be negotiated at runtime rather than fixed in advance
body.prose: A single federated interoperability holon is proposed to hold the other holons together without a shared model or central authority. Its barriers, its modes of alignment, its functions, its component architecture and its open costs make up the bulk of the contribution.

name: The federating holon that binds the rest

body.matters: whether a shared representation layer is imposed or left out
body.prose: Interoperability is broken into conceptual, organisational and technical barriers, spread across data, service, process and business concerns, and then sorted into integrated, unified and federated approaches. The federated mode is singled out as the one that lets systems keep their own models.

body.matters: how long an alignment lives and how much of a holon's internals it must expose
body.prose: Federated interoperability is treated as something settled while the system runs, through short-lived ontologies, schema mapping and negotiated interfaces. The holon keeps its internal logic, and only the mediation between holons is dynamic.
